scope: Retained FY2027 project and allocation observations; source/stage ledgers overlap. Never sum across datasets.
identity_policy: One row per source observation, linked to the existing upstream comparison groups; no certified physical-project identity asserted.
title_policy: Preserve title/title_source; display and match locations against title_clean. Coordinate parsing retains the original title. Stage amounts and upstream analysis_record remain separate.
legislative_district_policy: Lookup of the final assigned location through the verified PSGC2LEG municipality-to-district assignments; unscored and never new location evidence. Bridge-registry records carry the bridge coordinate-derived district.

psgc_foundation.replacement_plan: swap to official PSA XLSX when network allows; structure identical
psgc_foundation.icc_note: mirror ICC=6 vs PSA announcement 5: Isabela City counted as ICC in mirror; PSA lists it with '(Not a Province)' annotation. Kept as ICC; does not affect municipality-level LEG joins.

location_policy: Provisional exact name inference only. Printed office/region context is not a project site. No generated coordinates or fuzzy matching.

location_score_rules.interpretation: Uncapped additive evidence score; not normalized and not a probability.
